name: SCR reagent systems (ammonia/urea storage, dosing, injection grids; ammonium sulfate/bisulfate in HRSGs)
description: Store and deliver aqueous ammonia (or anhydrous ammonia / urea) to an ammonia injection grid (AIG) upstream of the SCR catalyst; tuning of AIG distribution controls NOx removal, ammonia slip and downstream ammonium bisulfate (ABS) / ammonium sulfate (AS) deposition on air-preheater or HRSG tube surfaces. Flow-correction devices (turning vanes, static mixers, graduated straightening grids) and CFD are used to obtain uniform NH3/NOx distribution.

specifications.metric: Aqueous ammonia concentration and injection rate at a 2x1 combined cycle
specifications.basis: At plant design operating conditions for HRSG SCR; W501FC+ gas turbines, gas-only full-load rating 480 MW at 120 F/15% RH

specifications.metric: HRSG module gas-side pressure drop before/after dry-ice cleaning
specifications.unit: inches H2O (clean condition 2.1; rises to 6.8 or more)
specifications.basis: Module 5 (LP evaporator, IP economiser, HP economiser) of each HRSG; fouling attributed to ammonium bisulfate deposition; ~5 in H2O increase cost about 1-1.5 MW output
